_comment: A complete BehaviourSpec, used to exercise M3 in CI without needing an
OpenRouter key. It is shaped exactly like the output of
The content describes a hypothetical expense tracker. It is deliberately
not derived from any real app, and not from any model.
purpose: A simple expense tracker for people who want to see where their money went this month, without connecting a bank account.
target_users: People who want a plain expense log and a monthly total.

screens.name: Expense List
screens.purpose: See every recorded expense for the current month

data_stored.name: expenses
data_stored.description: amount, category and date per entry

network_calls.purpose: Back up expenses to the user's own bucket

permissions_justified.android.permission.INTERNET: Sends backups to the configured server.

platform_dependencies: local storage for the expense database
caveats: Category breakdown appears stubbed in the original and may be dead code.
The Settings screen was inferred at low confidence and needs hand-checking.
